title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Says 'Every Model Is Substitutable' — What That Means For OpenAI

Microsoft Corp. used its fiscal fourth-quarter earnings call to deliver upbeat updates on Azure, Copilot and AI spending. But one of the company's most consequential messages for investors wasn't about cloud growth or capital expenditures — it was about the future role of AI models themselves.

Throughout the call, CEO Satya Nadella emphasized that Microsoft's AI strategy is increasingly built around model choice rather than dependence on any single AI provider. Instead of betting exclusively on OpenAI, Microsoft is building a platform where customers can mix and match models based on cost, performance and use case.

Microsoft Is Building a Multi-Model AI Platform

While OpenAI remains one of Microsoft's closest AI partners, Nadella said Azure now offers customers broad model choice.

"We offer the broadest model catalog in the cloud with over 11,000 models, including the latest from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, as well as our own MAI family," he said.

Microsoft said customer adoption is accelerating. Nadella said the company has seen "5x increase in the number of customers building with models from multiple providers."

He cited Levi Strauss & Co., which is using both OpenAI and Anthropic models through Microsoft's Foundry platform while deploying more than 1,000 domain-specific AI agents.

Trending: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time

The clearest signal came when Nadella explained how Microsoft is designing its AI platform.

"We are building a new model system where the harness, context, memory, and action space are separate from any one model family." He said the approach improves more than just efficiency. "It also has the added benefit of business continuity and resilience because every model is substitutable."

The theme carried into the analyst Q&A. CFO Amy Hood said Microsoft is intentionally separating the software layer from the underlying model so enterprises can switch providers over time.

"You've got to keep your harness separate from the model… That means any given model at any given time is swappable," Hood said.

Nadella reinforced the point moments later, arguing enterprises shouldn't become dependent on a single AI provider. "The biggest thing that we should take away from that is you can't depend on any one model," he said.

微软公司在第四财季财报电话会议上发布了有关 Azure、Copilot 和人工智能支出的乐观最新消息。 但该公司对投资者最重要的信息之一不是关于云增长或资本支出，而是关于人工智能模型本身的未来角色。

在整个电话会议中，首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉（Satya Nadella）强调，微软的人工智能战略越来越多地围绕模型选择而建立，而不是依赖于任何单一的人工智能提供商。 微软并没有专门押注于 OpenAI，而是正在构建一个平台，客户可以根据成本、性能和用例混合和匹配模型。

微软正在构建多模型人工智能平台

尽管 OpenAI 仍然是微软最亲密的人工智能合作伙伴之一，纳德拉表示 Azure 现在为客户提供了广泛的模型选择。

“我们在云端提供最广泛的模型目录，包含超过 11,000 个模型，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic、Mistral、xAI 以及我们自己的 MAI 系列的最新模型，”他说。

微软表示，客户的采用正在加速。 纳德拉表示，该公司“使用多个提供商的模型进行构建的客户数量增加了 5 倍”。

他引用了 Levi Strauss & Co. 的例子，该公司正在通过 Microsoft 的 Foundry 平台使用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型，同时部署 1,000 多个特定领域的 AI 代理。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

当纳德拉解释微软如何设计其人工智能平台时，发出了最清晰的信号。

“我们正在构建一个新的模型系统，其中的安全带、上下文、记忆和动作空间与任何一个模型系列都是分开的。” 他说，这种方法不仅仅提高了效率。 “它还具有业务连续性和弹性的额外好处，因为每种模型都是可替代的。”

该主题贯穿于分析师问答环节。 首席财务官 Amy Hood 表示，微软有意将软件层与底层模型分开，以便企业可以随着时间的推移更换提供商。

“你必须将你的安全带与模型分开...... 这意味着任何给定的模型在任何给定的时间都是可以互换的，”胡德说。

纳德拉稍后强调了这一点，认为企业不应该依赖单一的人工智能提供商。 “我们应该从中吸取的最重要的一点是，你不能依赖任何一种模型，”他说。
